results.title: PSYCHO
results.overview: When a ruthless highway bandit known for his brutal killings resurfaces after years on the run, an ordinary traveler becomes the only witness to his crimes. Wrongly accused by the police and hunted by a merciless psychopath, he must clear his name, save a young woman from captivity, and stop a killer before more innocent lives are lost.

results.title: A Common Story
results.overview: Erika and Mauro live in the province, living a simple life made up of reassuring habits and small gestures. When their daughter Irene leaves to study abroad, the house empties, and the balance on which the couple has built their existence seems to be shaken.

results.title: Demons at Dawn
results.overview: Orlando and Marco, two young men who live in Mexico City, meet by chance and fall in love. Every day they fight in order to achieve their dreams: Orlando wants to be a dancer and Marco wants to graduate from nursing school. As they go against a diverse, ever-changing, hostile world, they’ll learn that once the darkness of night is gone and through their intertwined bodies and their synchronized souls, they will have seen all those demons of dawn go by.

results.title: Till' jail do us part
results.original_title: Hasta que la celda nos separe
results.overview: A couple of criminals challenge both love and the law to achieve the wedding of their dreams. Liza, determined to stay in her country despite financial hardships, convinces her boyfriend Joseph to go through with a heist that Las Vejigantes, the crime syndicate he works for, had explicitly abandoned. What starts as a simple art gallery theft, quickly escalates into an unexpected marriage proposal, a chaotic series of heists, police chases, and a media frenzy.

results.title: Oil
results.overview: A mother takes her young son to the beach in an attempt to rebuild their relationship. But what begins as a day of reconciliation shifts when a mysterious presence emerges from the sea, drawing them both into a journey of fear and mystery.

results.title: A-Men to That
results.overview: A musical odyssey in male friendships seen through three x male models with a desperate grip on their youth entering the world of pop and trying to become a man-band.

results.title: Cocaine
results.overview: "Cocaine" is a gripping crime thriller that delves deep into the murky intersection of law enforcement and criminality. Set against the vibrant yet perilous backdrop of Mumbai, the story revolves around a powerful drug cartel that wields significant control over the cocaine trade with the connivance of corrupt police officials and politicians. Abhimanyu Singh stars as Jalal, a diligent police inspector who finds himself entangled in the cartel's sinister web. Despite his best efforts to stay above board, Jalal must go to extreme lengths to protect his own brother, who is targeted by the ruthless cartel. As Jalal navigates the perilous dualities of upholding the law while safeguarding his family, he becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of survival.

results.title: I Understand Your Displeasure
results.overview: Heike works at a cleaning company, where every day she has to handle her team’s struggles, the pressure of delivering a spotless job, and the need to keep clients and boss happy. When a powerful subcontractor threatens to withdraw his support if she does not provide more work for his team, Heike faces a difficult choice. To comply, she must sacrifice one of her own employees. As the pressure closes in, Heike must decide how far she is willing to go to meet the job’s ruthless demands.

results.title: City Lights
results.overview: Follows two individuals who move from a village to Bengaluru, only to confront the harsh realities of survival in a fast-paced, indifferent city.

results.title: Papertowel Maxipad
results.overview: In this hand-drawn animated farce, a young woman wakes in a frat house to discover a horrifying mistake she must conceal before her situationship wakes up. As her panic escalates and every solution fails, the morning spirals toward an act of grotesque self-preservation.

results.title: The Soloist
results.overview: A cynical actor, Lev, is fired from the theater where he has worked his entire life. In order to earn a living, he finds himself in a psychiatric hospital, pretending to be mentally ill. There, he commits a serious crime, and the question arises: who is he - a mentally ill person or a brilliant actor?

results.title: Abang: Path to Return
results.overview: Orphaned at a young age, Uwais and his younger sister, Hasnah, are taken in by their uncle Usop, a loan shark who raises them within an illegal moneylending syndicate. While Uwais struggles to hold on to his remaining moral compass, Hasnah spirals deeper into gambling and self-destruction. Under the influence of the powerful Haji Daud, they become trapped in a dangerous criminal network, forcing Uwais to confront rival gangs, buried loyalties and the system that shaped his life. Amid violence and betrayal, he must decide who he truly is and what he is willing to sacrifice to reclaim his identity and redefine the meaning of family.

results.title: UNTIL NEXT TIME
results.overview: After his fiancée's death, an emotionally unstable man is approached by a mysterious man who offers him a second chance to bring back what was lost at a deadly cost.

results.title: Three Kingdoms: The Beginning
results.overview: Toward the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, amid nationwide unrest, Cao Cao and Yuan Shao sought to enlist General-in-Chief He Jin’s support to check the power of the eunuchs and restore the Han Dynasty to its rightful order. Unexpectedly, Dong Zhuo seized the chaos to march his troops into the capital, plotting to dethrone the reigning emperor and install a new one.Swept up in the torrential tide of troubled times, a host of warlords emerged one after another: Yuan Shu, Lü Bu, Sun Jian, as well as Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. Turmoil engulfed Luoyang, and the fate of the great Han Empire stood at a crossroads…

results.title: Concert Anh Trai Vượt Ngàn Chông Gai Encore Day 7 & 8
results.original_title: Concert Anh Trai Vượt Ngàn Chông Gai Encore Day 7 & 8
results.overview: Day 7 and 8 in the series of concerts from the TV show Anh Trai Vượt Ngàn Chông Gai (Call Me by Fire).

results.title: Traces
results.overview: Despite the deep traces of trauma caused by sexual violence and torture at the hands of Russian troops, Ukrainian women survivors are uniting to break stigma and silence, transforming their testimonies into a powerful form of resistance.

results.title: String Theory
results.overview: Drawn by a mysterious thread, a distracted student is pulled far and wide in search of connection.

results.title: A Song for the Snow Lion
results.original_title: A Song for the Snow Lion
results.overview: As the Himalayan glaciers vanish, a cellist and a Bhutanese folk singer come together across cultures and generations to honour an ancient story passed down through the ages, and to help protect the sacred mountains and glaciers that inspired it.
